name: dlt-connector
title_zh: SaaS 数据直通 SQL 分析，dlt 管道自动搭
tagline_zh: HubSpot、Stripe、Salesforce 说接就接，dlt 装好、凭证配好、管道跑完。
tagline_en: Connect HubSpot, Stripe, Salesforce & more—dlt installs, creds set, pipeline runs, Wren semantic project.
desc_en: Connect SaaS data (HubSpot, Stripe, Salesforce, GitHub, Slack, etc.) to Wren Engine for SQL analysis. Guides the user through the full flow: install dlt, pick a SaaS source, set up credentials, run the data pipeline into DuckDB, then auto-generate a Wren semantic project from the loaded data. Use this skill whenever the user mentions: connecting SaaS data, importing data from an API, dlt pipelines
why_zh: 把 dlt 的配置地狱变成向导式问答，凭证、源、目标一次理清，跑完数据连语义层都替你生成。
why_en: Turns dlt's config maze into a guided Q&A—credentials, source, destination sorted in one pass, then auto-builds the Wren.
limit_zh: 只认 dlt 官方列出的 SaaS 源，自定义 API 需自己写 dlt source；目标库固定 DuckDB。
limit_en: Only dlt's official SaaS sources; custom APIs need your own source code. Targets DuckDB only—Postgres/BigQuery need edits. Credential errors are.
title_en: SaaS data to SQL analysis via auto dlt pipelines
